GET /api/field-agent/tasks.description: List field agent tasks filtered by state (PENDING, ACCEPTED, IN_PROGRESS, FIELD_VISIT, REPORT_SUBMITTED, VERIFIED, REJECTED)

POST /api/field-agent/tasks/{task_id}/ac.description: Field Agent accepts a pending escalation task

POST /api/field-agent/tasks/{task_id}/re.description: Field Agent rejects a task. Requires non-empty reason.

POST /api/field-agent/tasks/{task_id}/ve.description: Submits field visit report and verification result (VERIFIED_DISEASE, NOT_VERIFIED, INCONCLUSIVE)

POST /api/field-agent/evaluate-telemetry.description: Evaluates IoT sensor telemetry for range, rapid drop, and suspicious zero readings

GET /api/notifications/farmer/{farmer_id.description: Returns farmer notifications with genuine lifecycle delivery tracking states

POST /api/notifications/{notification_id.description: Transitions notification status to READ upon farmer viewing
